name: Collection Listings
description: Experimental Collection submodule: a Paragraphs behavior that renders a filtered, ordered listing of a collection's items.
project_description: Experimental submodule of Collection. Provides a Paragraphs behavior plugin (collection_listing) that renders a filtered listing of the items in a referenced collection. Add a collection entity-reference field to a paragraph type and enable the Collection listing behavior; editors then choose the entity types, bundles, view modes and item count to render.
